metadata.title: Sovereign Network Defense: IT & Cyber Resilience
metadata.notes: Defensive epistemics and technical security for the Mycelix mesh.

nodes.title: Physical Root-of-Trust
nodes.description: Securing the hardware node. Understanding TPM/HSM modules, BIOS protection, and physical tampering detection for off-grid mesh servers (SBCs).

nodes.title: Mesh Immunity & Sybil Resistance
nodes.description: Protecting the social fabric. Mathematical models for identifying fake identities (Sybils) and information-mining nodes. Using MATL as a defensive firewall.

nodes.title: Key Stewardship & Social Recovery
nodes.description: The physics of the private key. Threshold signatures (Shamir's Secret Sharing) and pod-based social recovery protocols. Preventing permanent data loss.

nodes.title: HDC & Post-Quantum Resilience
nodes.description: Using high-dimensional math as a shield. Why HDC vectors are naturally resilient to signal jamming and noise-injection attacks. (Ref. HDC Sandbox).

nodes.title: The Mesh Architect Capstone
nodes.description: Design and execute a stress-test for a local pod-mesh. Successfully identify a simulated Sybil attack and maintain network coherence during a physical blackout.

holonic_capstone.deliverable: A verified 'Network Immunity Report' showing zero structural leakage and successful social recovery of a test key.

edges.rationale: Foundational cryptographic literacy is required for advanced key stewardship.
Graph theory provides the mathematical tools for identifying Sybil-subgraphs.
Post-quantum resilience training is an application of high-dimensional computing logic.
